title.narrative: National inventory of banks of used or unwanted controlled substances and a plan

description.narrative: Tunisia will build on ongoing HPMP and HFC phase-down activities to prepare a comprehensive national inventory of banks of used and unwanted controlled substances (HCFCs, HFCs and others) and to develop a national action plan for their life-cycle management. The project will apply the methodology and guidelines of Multilateral Fund Executive Committee, using equipment-based and/or chemical consumption approaches, and will include a desk review, detailed field surveys, data collection across key consuming sectors and stakeholder consultations. The inventory will quantify and map the main substances, sectors and locations, and assess their potential for recovery, recycling and reclamation within a national RRR system. Based on these results, the project will design a plan for the collection, transport and environmentally sound management of these substances, including options for local recycling, reclamation, destruction and, where relevant, export for destruction. The project will also identify regulatory and policy needs and will be closely linked with existing initiatives (HPMP, KIP and refrigeration servicing programmes) to ensure a coherent, long-term national strategy for managing banks of used and unwanted controlled substances.
